Forma — Simple, Transparent Pricing

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a SaaS pricing page with the following structure:

1. HEADER
- "Simple, Transparent Pricing"
- "No hidden fees. Cancel anytime."
- Monthly/Annual toggle (annual shows 20% discount)

2. PRICING CARDS (3 tiers, horizontal layout)

FREE TIER:
- Price: $0/month
- "For individuals getting started"
- Features: 3 projects, 1 user, 1GB storage, Email support
- CTA: "Get Started" (outline button)

PRO TIER (highlighted as "Most Popular"):
- Price: $15/user/month ($12 if annual)
- "For growing teams"
- Features: Unlimited projects, Up to 20 users, 50GB storage, Priority support, Advanced analytics, Custom integrations
- CTA: "Start Free Trial" (solid button)

ENTERPRISE TIER:
- Price: "Custom"
- "For large organizations"
- Features: Everything in Pro, Unlimited users, Unlimited storage, Dedicated support, SLA guarantee, Custom contracts, SSO/SAML
- CTA: "Contact Sales" (outline button)

3. FEATURE COMPARISON TABLE
- Full feature matrix comparing all 3 plans
- Checkmarks and X marks for feature availability
- Categories: Core Features, Collaboration, Security, Support

4. FAQ SECTION
- "Can I change plans later?"
- "What payment methods do you accept?"
- "Is there a free trial?"
- "What happens when I exceed my limits?"
- "Do you offer refunds?"

5. ENTERPRISE CTA
- "Need a custom solution?"
- "Talk to our sales team for enterprise pricing"
- Contact form or "Schedule a Demo" button

Design: Clean cards with subtle shadows, highlight the recommended plan with a colored border or badge.
